title: Fix the Domino Tiling Count
statement: Read n. The program below is supposed to compute, using recursion with memoization, the number of ways to fully tile a 2xn board using 1x2 dominoes (a board of width 0 has exactly 1 way: place nothing). It has 3 bugs. Fix them so it passes all test cases.
hints: How many ways are there to tile a board of width 0? Check the n == 0 base case against that.
The recurrence for tiling a 2xn board should combine the counts for two DIFFERENT smaller widths, not the same width twice
When you've already cached a result for this exact `n`, make sure you look it up by that same `n`, not by a different key
